findings.summary: Installation-scoped UAR administration state was queried once per Boss conversation and relabelled as conversation-owned.
resolution: Prometheus-AGS/the-boss@958c67b56d queries the shared principal once and attributes run-scoped records only from explicit host conversation identity.
Prometheus-AGS/the-boss@1229c49c58 exposes resources without host identity once as Shared installation across all locales.
Gate V uses two distinct Boss conversations and proves the run and approval lifecycle appear exactly once under the originating conversation.

findings.summary: Dynamic UAR settings and federated agent controls lacked programmatic names and linked feedback.
resolution: Prometheus-AGS/the-boss@be0c9bc011 adds labels, described validation errors and live status/error semantics.
Gate V reports zero unnamed visible controls, operational keyboard focus and no narrow-layout overflow.

reviewCoverage: approval lifecycle persistence, reconnect and restart invalidation
